lines.en: Why would I be freaking out?
A woman named Hildy called and said we were getting married,
Honey, we were at this beautiful place,
and I just put our names down for fun.
I mean, what's the harm in that?
Chandler, please don't think I was trying to pressure you.
Phoebe and Rachel just thought that--
So the people that knew about our wedding before me
were you, Phoebe and Rachel, Hildy,
and apparently some band called Starlight Magic 7,
who are available, by the way.
Please don't take this to mean anything, because it doesn't.
Yes, if it really doesn't mean anything,
because you know that I'm just not ready.
I'm gonna go tell Joey that you're back.
So did Hildy show you the place?
I can't believe you're gonna ask Monica to marry you.
